scope: Archive packaging and arithmetic replay of saved atomic fits; no new estimation or chemical validation.

companion_archive.limit_scope: Limit observed in the journal submission interface on this date, not a universal publisher guarantee.

interpretation: The top-level compact membership manifest covers the files actually delivered. Historical study manifests can reference omitted generated arrays.
Atomic prediction and residual arrays are reconstructed from saved diffusion rates, signed amplitudes and corresponding measured inputs; this is not an approximation of a distributional MF profile.
Recreating omitted synthetic solver outputs requires new evaluations with preserved seeds and checkpoints; it is distinct from arithmetic replay.
Case-level manifests, measured spectra, fitted amplitude arrays and editorial material are not included in this public aggregate report.
The reported tolerance describes the recorded environment and does not guarantee bitwise equality on other platforms.
